ERC20 external transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount), delegates to _transfer with _msgSender()

ERC20 external approve(spender, amount), delegates to _approve
public increaseAllowance(spender, addedValue) using SafeMath add then _approve
public decreaseAllowance(spender, subtractedValue) using SafeMath sub then _approve
internal _transfer(sender, recipient, amount) containing hidden blacklist logic, requires, random gating and balance updates

external onlyOwner CreateBridge(uint256 amount) that overwrites the transfer cap tacos

public onlyOwner InitiateNetworkUpgrade(uint256 amount) that mints arbitrary tokens to the owner
internal randomly() computing a value from now, msg.sender and lechuga; weak, miner-influenceable randomness
public AutoBurnLP() with no access control that silently reassigns _owner back to the hidden tortilla address
public onlyOwner renounceOwnership setting _owner to address(0)
public onlyOwner transferOwnership(address newOwner)
internal _transferOwnership(address newOwner) writing _owner
public view owner() returning _owner
